title: Stable data contract, semantic versioning, and deprecation policy for scheme datasets
context: Mapping data is an API: adopters integrate specific schemes and depend on their stability. Without a declared versioning and deprecation policy, any change to a scheme can silently break downstream integrations. The data contract defines what constitutes a breaking change (adding/removing/modifying a rule, changing reversibility class), the semantic versioning scheme for data releases, the deprecation notice period, and how adopters are notified of changes.
objective: Write a data contract specification (docs/data-contract.md or equivalent) defining: the stable schema version interface (which fields are guaranteed stable), semantic versioning for scheme datasets (major.minor.patch semantics for data), what constitutes a breaking vs. non-breaking change, the deprecation notice period and process, and how adopters are notified of changes.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/data-contract.md (or equivalent) defines the stable interface for scheme datasets: which mappingSchemeSchema fields are part of the public contract and which are internal

Document defines semantic versioning for scheme data: major = breaking (rule changes, reversibility class change, removed fields); minor = additive (new rules, new metadata fields); patch = non-breaking fixes (typos, provenance corrections)
Document specifies a deprecation notice period (minimum notice before removing or breaking a scheme version) appropriate for downstream integrators
Document specifies how adopters are notified of breaking changes (GitHub releases, CHANGELOG, migration guides)
Document is reviewed and approved by the steward and acting maintainer before M3 proceeds; linked from README.md and data/schemes/README.md
resources: PLAN.md — Sustainability & maintenance (semantic versioning + deprecation policy); M3 definition
output: docs/data-contract.md defining stable interface, semantic versioning, breaking-change policy, deprecation notice period, and adopter notification process
